card.name: Linking words inside technical phrases
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or mid-phrase nouns (which, the, human, variables, capacities) in the middle of technical or scientific sentences, just before a noun or clause continues. Also the slash in paired drug doses.

modes.label: Linking words in clauses
modes.description: Words like which, the, to, or less that sit before the rest of a technical clause.
modes.example: will be independent of the velocity of the system in<< which>> they are measured.

modes.label: Modifier before a noun
modes.description: A plural noun or adjective such as variables, capacities or human that is followed by a further noun phrase.

modes.label: Slash or digit in doses
modes.description: A slash between paired drug strengths or a digit inside a volume.
